evidence: Located on Phạm Hùng Street, adjacent to the National Convention Center, this architectural gem is a masterful blend of modernity and contemplation, as if the past and present of Hanoi are engaged in a dialogue. The museum's inauguration in 2010 marked a significant milestone, commemorating the Millennial Anniversary of Thăng Long – Hà Nội, the thousand-year-old city that has been the capital of Vietnam since the Edict on the Transfer of the Capital.
